The '''Silk Chasm''' is the lair of [[Venenatis]]. It is a [[multi-combat]] [[dungeon]] located in the [[Wilderness]], just south-east of [[Callisto's Den]]. Entering the boss lair requires completion of the [[Wilderness Diary#Medium|medium Wilderness diary]] '''OR''' a Venenatis boss Slayer task, '''and''' a fee of 50,000 coins; this fee does not need to be brought along in the inventory, and can be deducted from the bank. This fee is shared across [[Callisto's Den]], [[Hunter's End]], the [[Skeletal Tomb]], [[Vet'ion's Rest]], the Silk Chasm, the [[Web Chasm]] and the [[Escape Caves]]. The fee does not need to be paid again, unless the player dies to another player without having left the Wilderness since their most recent visit to a boss lair or the Escape Caves. If this happens, the fee is dropped as loot for the killer, and needs to be paid again to re-enter the boss lairs. Players can decrease the fee by killing the six bosses; each kill in which the player deals the most damage to it reduces the fee by 10,000 coins.

[[File:Wilderness bosses map.png|thumb|left|300px|The entrances to the boss lairs and the Escape Caves.]]
Like the [[Callisto's Den]] and [[Vet'ion's Rest]], players exiting the Silk Chasm will always arrive at one of three points within the [[Escape Caves]] at random. Note that any player who exits within 10 seconds of the previous player will arrive at the same point, meaning [[player killers]] can pursue their targets through the boss lair.

Upon any player entering the lair, all players inside will be unable to [[teleport]] for 3 [[ticks]]. This delay no longer occurs after completion of the [[Wilderness Diary#Hard|hard Wilderness diary]].

In order to peek inside the lair, the player must have at least 20 kills registered in their name.
